title: 이제 결심했어요: 우산을 사야겠어요
objective: By the end, you can choose the right form of -어야겠- (-아야겠-, -어야겠-, -해야겠-) and use it to say what you have decided to do in a situation.
summary: Learn how to use -아야겠-/-어야겠-/-해야겠- to say what you have just decided to do.

task.title: Say what you will do
task.line: Use the verb in brackets with -아야겠-, -어야겠-, or -해야겠- to say what you decide to do in each situation.

forms.when: The last vowel of the verb stem is ㅏ or ㅗ. 가 + 아 becomes 가; 오 + 아 becomes 와.
forms.means: I've decided to ... / I think I should ... (a decision you make right now)
forms.example: 길이 많이 막히네요. 내일은 일찍 나와야겠어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: The traffic is really bad. I'll leave home early tomorrow.

forms.when: The last vowel of the verb stem is not ㅏ or ㅗ.
forms.exampleMeaning: I have a fever. I'd better take some medicine.

forms.means: I've decided to ... / I'll have to ...
forms.example: 다음 주가 시험이에요. 이번 주말에는 도서관에서 공부해야겠어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: My exam is next week. I'm going to study at the library this weekend.

forms.when: Plain form. Used when you talk to yourself or speak casually.
forms.means: Same meaning: a decision you make in the moment.
forms.exampleMeaning: Oh, there's no milk. I'd better go to the store.

watchOut: 먹아야겠어요 (X) → 먹어야겠어요 (O): 먹 has ㅓ, so use -어야겠-. Only ㅏ and ㅗ take -아야겠-.
가아야겠어요 (X) → 가야겠어요 (O): After ㅏ, the two ㅏ sounds become one. In the same way, 오다 becomes 와야겠어요.
듣어야겠어요 (X) → 들어야겠어요 (O): In verbs like 듣다 and 걷다, ㄷ changes to ㄹ before a vowel.
공부하야겠어요 (X) → 공부해야겠어요 (O): For 하다 verbs, always use 해야겠어요.
exercises: Fill in the blank with the verb in brackets: 이 바지가 너무 작아요. 큰 사이즈로 ____. (바꾸다)
Choose the correct form: 방이 너무 더워요. 창문을 (열아야겠어요 / 열어야겠어요).
Fill in the blank with the verb in brackets: 휴대폰 배터리가 거의 없어요. 지금 ____. (충전하다)
Fill in the blank with the verb in brackets: 이 노래 정말 좋네요. 한 번 더 ____. (듣다)
Read the situation and say what you decide to do, using -어야겠어요: ① 냉장고에 물이 없어요. (물을 사다) ② 이가 너무 아파요. (치과에 가다)
You are talking to yourself. Say what you decide to do, using -어야겠다: ① 벌써 12시네. (이제 자다) ② 지갑을 집에 두고 왔네. (다시 돌아가다)
answers: ① 물을 사야겠어요. ② 치과에 가야겠어요.
① 이제 자야겠다. ② 다시 돌아가야겠다.
